screen.title: Privacy
screen.heading: Who can see {name}'s details
screen.intro: Choose who in the family tree can see each detail. Immediate family means parents, children, partners and siblings.
screen.yearNote: Birth and death years are always visible to the family tree, so ages and words like elder/younger brother work.

contacts.title: Contact details
contacts.hiddenNote: Contact details are private. Only the person (or a tree owner, if the profile isn't claimed) can see and change them.
contacts.privateHint: Private unless the person chooses to share them.

country.label: Country they live in
country.hint: Used to protect children: below this country's age limit, only close family can see their details.

minor.name: Private family member
minor.note: This is a child. Their details are visible to close family only.

note.title: About privacy
note.link: How we protect your family's privacy
note.body1: MyOrbit stores the family trees you create: names, how people are related, birth and death dates, and contact details you add.
note.body2: Only members of a family tree can see it. Within the tree, birth dates (day and month) are visible to immediate family by default, and contact details are private by default. Each person can change this for their own profile.
note.body3: Children below their country's age limit are shown to others as "Private family member"; only their close family can see their details.
note.body4: Birth and death years are visible to the whole tree, so ages and kinship words can be worked out. People who have died are shown to the whole family tree.
note.body5: Your data is stored with Supabase. It is never sold or shown to anyone outside your family trees.
